verdict.rationale: Vestd documents some multi-item actions: distributing a share pool to one or more recipients in a single step, and sending updates to segmented stakeholder mailing lists. These are narrow, feature-specific batch actions, not a general bulk-operations capability, and nothing shows bulk actions that an AI-native user could run programmatically. missing for 10: general bulk select/edit across item types (grants, shareholders, documents), bulk import/export documentation, programmatic or API-driven bulk operations (no OpenAPI spec found), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Authorise a share pool and choose a share class, then instantly distribute the equity to one or more recipients.
Create bespoke mailing lists to segment stakeholders, to send targeted updates to specific groups.
